reason: Honestly the idea of fixing prices by just texting is nice, I raised prices twice this year and the old site still shows the old ones. But my own domain is only on the 40 € plan, so on 25 € I'd be renting a site on someone else's address, and if I stop paying I'm back to zero again.
objection: If I stop paying, what stays mine? My domain, my menu, my Google profile. I don't want to be locked in to a monthly bill for something I already paid a freelancer for once.
would_change_my_mind: A clear promise that my own domain works on the 25 € plan and that if I cancel I keep the domain, can export the site and menu, and my Google profile stays untouched.
